chapter: Boyhood scene: halls and dance music
title: Sneaking around good time houses and the piano wagons
summary: As a boy he peeked into bars and heard piano players; he describes the piano on a wagon hired out from bar to bar.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Did you ever sneak around to the dance halls or any place you shouldn't be when you were a kid?

I was always sneaking around, peeking through windows, peeking through cracks, looking at them good time houses. I hear a piano punkin' old guitar, they're saying, they're always bashing by the music. I stopped and listened. Most of the bar rooms had a piano in the back. And there were these guys that would pull the organs around. What kind of organ is that? A regular organ, like a, no, it was a piano.
They called them organs. And they had a shaft on them like a wagon.
A guy would pull these things from bar them to bar them. A special name of it, but I can't think of it right now.
this piano. And played a current popular tune. It was like an inner piano.
It was like an inner piano. same idea as a Nickelodeon, Altheon, that's right. But it was portable. It was on wheels.

And it was sitting on the wagon like this, two wheel wagon, you know, and sitting there and they had a regular contraption built that they sat inside of this. And the guy would hire it for a day, guaranteed to get a guy who owned it so much money. And he put it from bar to bar. A lot of guys made their living like this. And they had a big old bucket on it, so he would, at a corner he stopped to borrow it. The bartender would give him a pitcher of beer, a can of beer, a can of beer. He'd pass the hat around the bar and give him a few nickels and he'd go from bar to bar. It's called out there entertainment. Who would be in these good time houses? I mean,
